claim_class: established external experimental evidence plus project engineering bound
claim: For thick-film D18-class OSC scale transfer, zero-field mobility alone is not an adequate transport-screening criterion; field dependence, hopping/critical-length behavior, and direct extraction/collection evidence must remain visible before manufacturability or useful-work claims are promoted.

source.citation: Critical length screening enables 19% efficiency in thick-film organic solar cells, Nature Communications (2025)
facts_used: The paper reports that higher zero-field mobility does not necessarily correlate with longer critical length and argues that mobility, field dependence, and hopping frequency jointly control long-distance transport.
For 300 nm D18:L8-BO devices, adding BTP-eC9 reduced TPC extraction time from 0.93 us to 0.43 us.

The same comparison reduced defect-state density from 6.17e16 cm^-3 to 4.94e16 cm^-3, changed Jsc light-intensity exponent alpha from 0.97 to 0.99, reduced ideality factor from 1.89 to 1.70, and reduced FTPS Urbach energy from 23.0 meV to 20.8 meV.
The optimized 300 nm D18:L8-BO:BTP-eC9 device reached 19.0% PCE and the reported ternary critical length was 62.8 nm.

predeclared_checks.limiting_case: If modified equals control, ratio=1 and fractional reduction=0.
predeclared_checks.negative_control: If modified extraction time exceeds control, the code must report a slowdown rather than clamp to improvement.
predeclared_checks.domain: All times, densities, and energies used in ratios must be positive.

uncertainty.reason: The main-text values used here do not provide formal uncertainties for the selected summary quantities; none is invented.
uncertainty.reporting_resolution_sensitivity: Recompute extraction-time speedup over +/-0.005 us around each two-decimal reported TPC time; this is a reporting-resolution sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

validity_domain: The quantitative values apply to the source D18:L8-BO/BTP-eC9 thick-film systems and do not establish a numerical threshold for D18:eC9 or D18:PY-IT:eC9.
decision_delta: For future >=300 nm or area-scale D18/PY-IT/eC9 process transfer, zero-field mobility alone cannot satisfy the transport/manufacturability control. Require at least one field-sensitive transport/collection metric plus direct FF/stabilized-Pmax evidence under the scaled geometry.
serious_conventional_explanations: BTP-eC9 changes morphology, vertical composition, defect density, energetic disorder, and recombination simultaneously; the extraction improvement is not attributable to critical length alone.
The source host is D18:L8-BO rather than D18:eC9 or D18:PY-IT:eC9, so effect magnitude and optimum composition need not transfer.
TPC extraction time is method- and device-capacitance-dependent and is not a unique mobility or microscopic transport constant.
falsifier: The project-level bound would be narrowed if target D18/PY-IT/eC9 scale-transfer data showed that zero-field mobility alone prospectively predicts thick-film FF/stabilized-Pmax and collection across held-out lots/thicknesses as well as field-sensitive transport metrics within predeclared uncertainty.
